program.title: Controlled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Workflow Implementation Consultant
program.positioning: Help a small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) find one worthwhile operational problem, improve the process, implement a controlled artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted workflow in the systems it already uses, train the people involved, and prove the result.
program.durableValue: The durable skill is controlled implementation: understand the process, check data quality, apply fixed rules that give the same result for the same input, link evidence, keep human approval, test failures, help people adopt the change, measure results, and hand over clear instructions. A particular AI model or workflow screen is only a replaceable tool.

course.title: Controlled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Workflow Foundations
course.subtitle: From zero technical knowledge to one safe, evidence-backed small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) workflow
course.learnerStartingPoint: No coding, automation, consulting, or AI implementation knowledge is assumed.
course.outcome: You can investigate a small operational workflow, decide what should and should not be automated, and build a small prototype with clear limits, fixed checks, evidence, human approval, testing, and a documented manual way of working.

capstone.title: Synthetic SME Operations Exception Assistant
capstone.summary: A local-first demonstration that reads a fictional CSV export, detects operational exceptions with deterministic rules, uses AI only for bounded issue-linked explanation, and produces a review package for a human decision.
nonGoals: It is not a production SaaS product.
It does not take autonomous external action.
It does not use real employer, patient, client, or commercially confidential data.
It is not a Veeva, eQMS, accounting, CRM, or ERP replacement.

career.title: Career sequence
career.summary: This progressive web app (PWA), an installable website that can keep working without an internet connection, teaches Course 1 in full. The remaining courses are separate future builds so technical foundations, consulting practice, rules and oversight, and commercial development are not confused with one another.
career.targetRole: Controlled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Workflow Implementation Consultant for Dutch Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs)

courses.title: Controlled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Workflow Foundations
courses.purpose: Start with no technical background, learn the basic tools and safety controls, then build one complete workflow using made-up (synthetic) data.
courses.exitEvidence: A tested Synthetic SME Operations Exception Assistant (a practice system that flags records which break stated rules), test evidence, a step-by-step operating guide (runbook), and a plain-language case study.

courses.title: Workflow Discovery and Paid Problem Assessments
courses.purpose: Learn to contact firms responsibly, interview and observe how work is done, measure current time and cost, check whether existing tools already solve the problem, rank opportunities, write a fixed-scope problem assessment (diagnostic), and propose a small trial plan (pilot charter).
courses.exitEvidence: A complete fictional problem assessment, interview script, fixed-scope report, and small-trial recommendation with success and stop criteria.

courses.title: Connect Small-Business Systems and Deliver a Small Trial
courses.purpose: Learn application programming interfaces (APIs), automatic event notices (webhooks), limited-access sign-in using Open Authorization (OAuth), prebuilt system links (connectors), minimum necessary access, separate test and live environments, trying a failed step again (retry), returning to a known safe state (rollback), client-owned software environments, user acceptance testing (UAT), and one small low-risk trial (pilot).
courses.exitEvidence: A reproducible system-connection practice lab plus a supervised low-risk trial or realistic isolated test environment (sandbox).

courses.title: Controlled Document AI Systems
courses.purpose: Build document workflows that keep original source files unchanged, read Portable Document Format (PDF) and Microsoft Word (.docx) files, use optical character recognition (OCR) for scans, cite exact source locations, extract fixed fields, retrieve approved policy text, draft from cited evidence, require exact-output approval, and evaluate results.
courses.exitEvidence: A controlled made-up supplier-document review system with tests proving that document reading, field extraction, evidence links, and human review still work.

courses.title: Controls for Secure and Reliable Live Systems
courses.purpose: Learn General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), called the Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) in Dutch, and European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) implementation records, vendor review, attack analysis, identity and permission controls, separate client environments, monitoring, incident response, backup, restore, deletion, and live-system acceptance.
courses.exitEvidence: A documented readiness pack for a low-risk fictional live system, plus failure and recovery exercises.

courses.title: Adoption, Consulting Delivery, and Ongoing Checks
courses.purpose: Learn to decide whether to accept a client request, write proposals and boundaries, control changes, teach people about AI for their role, help them adopt the change, measure benefits, design support, run recurring checks, and operate a solo consulting practice.
courses.exitEvidence: A complete fictional client pack, adoption plan, benefit review, and step-by-step procedure for recurring checks.

optionalSpecializations.title: Quality and Controlled-Document Operations
optionalSpecializations.purpose: Specialise later in evidence-heavy quality operations, information that describes documents (metadata), document control, training records, change control, and checking that records match across systems (reconciliation), without presenting yourself as a Veeva quality-document platform or regulated-systems expert before you have the required experience.

readinessGates: Do not sell systems that make decisions without human approval, or high-consequence clinical, employment, credit, legal, or safety workflows, as a beginner.
Use made-up (synthetic) or expressly authorised data until privacy, security, confidentiality, and client controls are understood.
Complete Course 1 before presenting implementation as a paid capability.
Complete Course 2 discovery practice before selling a build.
Validate demand with interviews and paid problem assessments before building a reusable product.

suggestedPace.currentCapacity: Use 15 planned hours plus up to 5 optional hours per week; health and return-to-work commitments take priority.
suggestedPace.laterCapacity: At 8–10 hours per week, keep one major learning or client objective active at a time.
suggestedPace.sequenceRule: Courses build on one another; they are not badges. Advance when the required proof is credible, not merely when every page is marked complete.
